skill.name: softsync-messages
skill.description: Read emails, notes and saved meeting summaries linked to records, search them by content, answer from the workspace's own help articles, and send a text. Use when the user asks what was said, agreed or sent — "what did Acme reply?", "summarise our last call" — asks a how-to or policy question, or wants to text someone.
skill.summary: Search linked workspace messages, answer policy questions from approved articles, and draft or send texts with confirmation.
skill.author: softsync-lab

content.value_statement: Important workspace messages can be difficult to find across records, topics, and saved notes. This skill retrieves linked evidence, answers from approved articles, and sends confirmed texts.
actual_capabilities: Search messages linked to a company or person after resolving related records.
Search workspace communications by topic when no entity is specified.
Retrieve the full text of a known message after locating its identifier.
Answer policy questions from workspace help articles and cite the source.
Draft or send a text after showing the exact recipient and message.
limitations: It only sees communications linked to accessible records or workspace users.
It cannot retrieve recordings that were never saved to a record.
It cannot recall a text after delivery to a real phone.
It cannot safely infer an entity from unrelated text-similar messages.

use_cases.title: Review a customer conversation
use_cases.description: Find recent emails, notes, and saved meeting summaries linked to a customer record, then summarize the evidence.

use_cases.title: Answer a policy question
use_cases.description: Search approved workspace articles for a policy or procedure and provide an answer based only on the cited passages.

use_cases.title: Send a confirmed follow-up
use_cases.description: Draft a concise SMS, show the exact recipient and text, then send it only after clear user approval.

prompt_templates.title: Find a recent reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the latest messages linked to Acme and summarize what they replied about the renewal.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve a simple entity-specific conversation.

prompt_templates.title: Search by topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Find workspace messages about the product launch from the last 30 days and list the main decisions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: search open-ended communication by topic and time.

prompt_templates.title: Answer from approved guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: What is our refund policy? Search the workspace help articles, quote the relevant passage, and name its source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: answer a policy question using approved internal material.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a safe text
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a text to Jordan confirming tomorrow's 10 AM meeting. Show the exact recipient and message, then wait for my approval before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare an external action with explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: What did Acme say about the renewal last week?
output_examples.output: I found two linked messages from last week. Acme requested revised pricing and asked for a response by Friday.

output: Source: Customer Help Center, Refunds article.
Refunds are available within 30 days when the account meets the article conditions.

output_examples.input: Text Jordan that I will arrive at 10 AM.
output_examples.output: Draft ready for Jordan at the confirmed phone number: I will arrive at 10 AM. Please confirm before I send it.

best_practices: Name the person or company and time range when asking about a specific conversation.
Use topic search only for open-ended questions without a named entity.
Review the exact recipient and text before approving any message.
anti_patterns: Do not treat text-similar messages as proof that they belong to a named company.
Do not answer workspace policy questions from memory when an article is required.
Do not send a text without showing its exact content and recipient first.

faq.question: What communications can this skill find?
faq.answer: It can find emails, notes, notifications, and saved meeting summaries linked to accessible records.

faq.question: Can it search by company or person?
faq.answer: Yes. It resolves the entity, expands related records, and searches messages linked to the complete record set.

faq.question: Can it search messages by topic?
faq.answer: Yes, when the request is open-ended and does not identify a specific company or person.

faq.question: Can it answer policy questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches workspace help articles and should cite the relevant source instead of answering from memory.

faq.question: Can it send SMS messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows the exact message and recipient, then waits for clear approval before sending.

faq.question: Why might expected messages be missing?
faq.answer: Messages may be unlinked, outside accessible records, unsynced, or stored as recordings that were never saved to a record.
